label: Meadows
name: Corrupted Meadows map
description: Drawn in ash on a slain guardian's hide. Use it to tear open a rip into unexplored Meadows. It crumbles once used.
notes: Material: the design names none, so the rule for unnamed biomes: the weakest creature found only in this biome (Boar, 10 health) and its guaranteed non-food drop. Amount: the median amount of LeatherScraps in vanilla recipes and building pieces (rounded up), i.e. what the game itself typically asks for. Shards and essence: 1 each, from the design doc.
